description: Get a shard iterator for reading stream records. Use TRIM_HORIZON for all records or LATEST for new records only.

sequence_number.description: Sequence number, 21 to 40 digits (required for AT/AFTER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER, refused for TRIM_HORIZON and LATEST)

shard_iterator_type.description: Iterator type: TRIM_HORIZON, LATEST, AT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER, or AFTER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER

name: get_shard_iterator
